title: 第一卷 第17章 我有那么差吗第一卷 第18章 皇室禁卫
content_zh:
林辰盘坐在地上，继续恢复。
张天雪已经彻底迷乱了，虽然被捆着，但还是一个劲的往林辰怀里钻。
林辰无奈，把她捆在石头上，免得乱动。
但绳子虽然粗，可毕竟挡不住一个千钧境的武者。
张天雪这会儿有点恐怖，眼睛都是红红的，很是渗人，感觉要把林辰整个人都吃下去，绳子都给挣断了。
好家伙，这么猛跟三刀把头打的时候怎么看不到？
挣断绳子，张天雪就又钻到林辰怀里，手脚并用，八爪鱼一般，把林辰整个人都“捆住”
了。
林辰深吸一口气，手掌在张天雪后脑拍了一下，将其击昏，但很快又恢复了过来。
“……”
最后，林辰放弃了，他不想把时间浪费在处理张天雪这件事上，他需要尽快恢复。
反正张天雪现在也是迷乱，只是抱着林辰，然后就不明白下一步该怎么做了。
看来对少女来说，这事需要双方配合。
如此，林辰就不管张天雪了，反正被她抱着也不会影响到修炼，将爆血丸留下的影响消除，林辰开始服用五品疗伤丹。
这虽不是六品疗伤丹，但配合九天斩神诀，应该足以清除王右思在他体内留下的剑意！
不过林辰并不想就这样简单的清除掉剑意。
王右思将剑意打入他体内，让他时刻痛苦，玄力难聚，总也要得一些好处才是！
林辰借助药力运转九天斩神诀，驾驭天钨与剑意对抗。
这将磨砺天钨的力量！
若是平时，这样做危险极大，毕竟战场乃是自己体内，剑意跳动，林辰的内腑、经络都将受损。

不过现在有九天斩神诀和五品疗伤丹兜底，足以让林辰施展！
王右思的剑意层叠震荡，有着诸多独到之处，林辰过去也曾经踏足凝意境，有着自己的剑意，此刻正好印证！
此刻，天钨的磨砺提升是一方面，为将来凝聚更强剑意做出积累，则是另一方面！
林辰将身体当做战场，以天钨对王右思的剑意，等同再战了一次！
而通过这一战，林辰对于天钨的了解更深了，丹田之中天钨的剑影也变得愈发凝实。
终于，在彻底清除剑意的那一刻，林辰境界突破，来到了霸罡境三重！
玄力成罡，霸道绝伦！
待身体完全恢复，林辰将体内躁动的力量平复下去。
现在的他还很弱，而在国都那一战他所有底牌尽出，那些追杀的强者应该都已经了解了他所具备的特性。
天钨的能力也会被分析。
一旦遭遇，再想要出其不意，如对战王右思一般有出奇制胜的效果，只怕很难。
而唯一的办法就是变强！
“吞噬龙脉，让我一路成长到了霸罡境二重，速度的确很快，但那可是龙脉！”
林辰心中思量。
与其说是进境快速，不如说，即便是龙脉的力量也仅仅让林辰晋升到霸罡境二重而已。
这九天斩神诀的剑，胃口当真大！
“龙脉难寻，不可能总是依靠龙脉晋升”
，林辰心中低语。
不过除开龙脉之外，能够辅助修炼的天材地宝倒也不在少数，比如珍稀的灵药，罕见的能量结晶。
以及出自大师之手的修炼大阵等。

林辰脑中浮现整个大魏的地图，此去百战废土沿途所经的要地不少，但为了保险起见还需从偏僻路径入手。
“古楼城，城外十楼山脉，一个月前曾传出消息有灵药成熟，并且伴随异象”
，林辰眸光闪动。
这消息，可信度有，但也不算高。
content_en:
Lin Chen sat cross-legged on the ground and continued to recover.
Zhang Tianxue was completely confused. Although he was tied up, he still kept digging into Lin Chen's arms.
Lin Chen had no choice but to tie her to a stone to prevent her from moving.
But although the rope is thick, it can't stop a warrior in the Qianjun realm.
Zhang Tianxue was a little scared now, his eyes were red and very oozing, and he felt like he wanted to eat Lin Chen's whole body, and the rope was broken.
Good guy, why can't you see it when you hit your head with three knives so hard?
After breaking the rope, Zhang Tianxue got into Lin Chen's arms again, using his hands and feet together like an octopus, "tying up" Lin Chen's whole body
.
Lin Chen took a deep breath and slapped Zhang Tianxue on the back of the head, knocking him unconscious, but he quickly recovered.
"..."
Finally, Lin Chen gave up. He didn't want to waste time dealing with Zhang Tianxue. He needed to recover as soon as possible.
Anyway, Zhang Tianxue was confused now. He just hugged Lin Chen and didn't know what to do next.
It seems that for the girl, this matter requires cooperation from both parties.
In this way, Lin Chen didn't care about Zhang Tianxue. Being held by her would not affect his practice anyway. After eliminating the impact of the blood-blasting pills, Lin Chen started taking the fifth-grade healing pill.
Although this is not a sixth-grade healing pill, but combined with the Nine Heavens God-Slaying Art, it should be enough to clear away the sword intention left by Wang Yousi in his body!
But Lin Chen didn't want to simply clear away the sword intent.
Wang Yousi penetrated the sword intention into his body, causing him constant pain. It was difficult to gather his profound strength, so he had to get some benefits!
Lin Chen used the power of medicine to run the Nine Heavens God-Slaying Art, and controlled the tungsten to fight against the sword.
This will sharpen Tiantungsten's power!
In normal times, this would be extremely dangerous. After all, the battlefield is within his own body. If the sword's intention beats, Lin Chen's internal organs and meridians will be damaged.
But now he has the Nine Heavens Killing God Technique and the fifth-grade healing elixir, which are enough for Lin Chen to use!
Wang Yousi's sword intention is layered and oscillating, and has many unique features. Lin Chen has also set foot in Ningyi Realm in the past and has his own sword intention, which is confirmed at this moment!
At this moment, Tiantungsten's improvement is on the one hand, and on the other hand it is the accumulation of stronger sword intent in the future!
Lin Chen treated his body as a battlefield, using Tiantungsten's sword intention against Wang Yousi, it was like fighting again!
Through this battle, Lin Chen gained a deeper understanding of Tiantungsten, and the shadow of Tiantungsten's sword in his dantian became more solid.
Finally, at the moment when the sword intent was completely eliminated, Lin Chen broke through and reached the third level of Ba Gang Realm!
Mysterious power becomes powerful, extremely domineering!
After his body fully recovered, Lin Chen calmed down the restless power in his body.
He is still very weak now, but in that battle in the capital, he had used all his cards, and those strong men who were chasing him should have understood his characteristics.
Tiantungsten's abilities will also be analyzed.
Once encountered, it would be very difficult to catch someone by surprise and achieve a surprise victory like when fighting against Wang Yousi.
And the only way is to become stronger!
"Swallowing the dragon veins allowed me to grow all the way to the second level of Ba Gang Realm. The speed is indeed very fast, but those are dragon veins!"
Lin Chen thought in his mind.
Rather than saying that he entered the country quickly, even the power of the dragon vein only allowed Lin Chen to be promoted to the second level of Ba Gang Realm.
This Nine Heavens Killing God Sword has a really big appetite!
"Dragon veins are hard to find, and you can't always rely on dragon veins for promotion."
, Lin Chen whispered in his heart.
However, in addition to dragon veins, there are also many heavenly materials and earthly treasures that can assist cultivation, such as rare elixirs and rare energy crystals.
As well as the training formations made by the master.
A map of the entire Wei Dynasty appeared in Lin Chen's mind. There were many important places along the way to the Wasteland of Hundred Wars, but for the sake of safety, it was necessary to start from remote routes.
"Gulou City, the Shilou Mountains outside the city, there was news a month ago that there was a mature elixir, and it was accompanied by visions."
, Lin Chen’s eyes flashed.
This news can beThe reliability is there, but not high.
